information_regime.model_inputs: semantic feature values and visibility tags only; no source names, candidate bindings, candidate indices, action ids, labels, bits, native slot indices, or source metadata
information_regime.candidate_mapping: ordered projection candidate occurrence i is mapped only to live native legal action i; candidate_order_source and exact counts are checked before selection
information_regime.multi_action_states: one shared action-conditioned categorical policy across all nonbattle screen types
information_regime.battle: same native Search-v2@400 in all arms and continuation suffixes

model.architecture: candidate scorer Linear(2048,128)-Tanh-Linear(128,64)-Tanh-Linear(64,1); state value Linear(2048,64)-Tanh-Linear(64,1) over mean candidate vector
model.initialization: seeded PyTorch default hidden layers; final actor layer N(0,0.0001), bias 0; value layer default seeded initialization

training.terminal_reward: heart_victory + terminal_floor/100.0; floor must be in [0,99]
training.policy_gradient: whole-run REINFORCE with within-block mean terminal reward baseline
training.branch_loss: separate completed-superior terminal branch action log-probability loss weighted by clipped positive terminal-reward delta

continuations.continuation_policy: same frozen policy on all later nonbattle choices plus same native Search-v2@400
continuations.candidate_order: descending frozen policy probability excluding sampled root action
continuations.eligible_training_examples: completed native terminal branch strictly superior to original sampled full run by lexicographic (heart victory, terminal floor)

resources.compile_cpu_measurement: Native CMake configure/build measured 65.18 CPU-s; separately built the pinned-source forced-projection fixture target and charged a conservative 150 CPU-s upper bound for its 50-translation-unit compile. Two required fixture invocations used 0.088656 CPU-s total; a wrong-mode smoke invocation that segfaulted used 0.031221 CPU-s and is charged. Historical native probes are charged 2 CPU-s; implementation plus validation is charged a conservative 600 CPU-s upper bound; the first protected preflight startup detected a missing config lock in 2.326358 CPU-s; the first source-identity preflight discovered separate but fixed native integration identities in 2.628354 CPU-s; the first candidate-binding preflight rejected a valid source-ordered candidate because the controller wrongly required omitted opaque bits/sanitized labels (2.710484 CPU-s); and the next preflight rejected an explicitly unavailable optional future field because the encoder wrongly required visibility/source (2.810066 CPU-s). No failed attempt consumed a training seed; each CPU-s remains charged.
resources.resume_boundary: atomic per-owner artifacts and per-block optimizer checkpoint; interrupted owner is deterministically replayed and all replay CPU remains charged

preflight_projection.method: actual setup and preflight CPU + worker check CPU + 800 still-unrun training/evaluation owner arms at 1.25 times maximum observed full-run CPU + full registered branch allowance + fixed engineering margin
